newsitem.title: UK: Lasmo surges, leads sector higher.
newsitem.headline: Lasmo surges, leads sector higher.

text.p: Oil exploration shares resumed their rally on Friday, still buoyed good news this week on exploration and firm oil prices, dealers said.
Shares in Lasmo, which have underperformed the sector recently, jumped 8p to 253-1/2, the highest level in about five years.
Shares in Enterprise Oil advanced 12p to 691, just off the record high at 695p set initially.
Shares in British Borneo, which surged yesterday after an upbeat analysts meeting with the company, added another 36p to 1355.
"British Borneo's meeting yesterday just highlighted the sector and people are very positive about it," said one market maker.
Shares in Shell Transport also rose. They were up 18p to 1071-1/2.
Shell Australia Ltd confirmed that a joint-venture exploration team had made an oil and gas find in the Browse Basin offshore northwest Australia nSYD15109.
